params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Vel'Koz}} {{tip|abilities}} apply a stack of ''Deconstruction'' to enemies hit for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vel'Koz's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Deconstruction'' to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
params.description2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pplevel|35 to 205}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.
params.notes:
* The stack duration will not be refreshed if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* {{pft}} Interaction between duration refresh on basic attacks and parry effects ({{tip|dodge}} and {{tip|block}}).

blurb.plain: Innate: Vel'Koz abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: The third stack consumes them all to deal bonus true damage.

description.plain: Innate: Vel'Koz's abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks on-hit and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

description2.plain: The third stack consumes them all to deal 35 – 205 (based on level) (+ 65% AP) bonus true damage.

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} fires a plasma bolt that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for a short time.
''Plasma Fission'' can be recast while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching max range.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} The bolt splits in two, each firing in perpendicular opposite directions.
params.blurb3: Whenever ''Plasma Fission'' kills an enemy, '''Vel'Koz''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|mana}}}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' fires a plasma bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 70% decaying over a duration.

''Plasma Fission'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2.6}} seconds}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vel'Koz''' splits the bolt in two {{tt|over {{fd|0.25}} seconds|Estimated}}, each part firing perpendicularly in opposite directions and applying the same effects to enemies hit.
params.description3: Whenever ''Plasma Fission'' kills an enemy, '''Vel'Koz''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|mana}}}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Mana Restored per Kill|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}|mana}}|Maximum Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|20*3 to 30*3}}|mana}}}}
params.notes:
* The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** Detonating the ability manually does not.
* ''Plasma Fission's'' damage applies before ''{{ais|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz}}''.
** This also ensures '''Vel'Koz''' does not lose ''Plasma Fission's'' restoration effect.
* An enemy cannot be hit by multiple bolts even when having blocked one with a {{tip|spell shield}}.
* The split occurs at a location 55 units in front of the primary bolt's final location.
* ''Plasma Fission'' can reach a maximum 1595 units diagonally (ignoring the split missile's width and enemy hitbox radius), reaching this distance after a total of about ~{{fd|1.65}} seconds.{{Effect at cast time end}}

blurb.plain:
Active: Vel'Koz fires a plasma bolt that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, slowing them for a short time. 
Plasma Fission can be recast while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching max range.

blurb2.plain: Recast: The bolt splits in two, each firing in perpendicular opposite directions.

blurb3.plain: Whenever Plasma Fission kills an enemy, Vel'Koz restores mana.

description.plain:
Active: Vel'Koz fires a plasma bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 70% decaying over a duration. 
Plasma Fission can be recast after 0.25 seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range.

description2.plain: Recast: Vel'Koz splits the bolt in two over 0.25 seconds, each part firing perpendicularly in opposite directions and applying the same effects to enemies hit.

description3.plain: Whenever Plasma Fission kills an enemy, Vel'Koz restores mana.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a brief delay, cascading through the area to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
params.blurb2: After a brief delay, the rift collapses, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
params.blurb3: '''Vel'Koz''' periodically stocks a charge of ''Void Rift'', up to a maximum of 2.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, cascading through the area over {{fd|0.65}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
params.description2: After {{tt|{{fd|0.75}} seconds|Estimated}}, the rift violently collapses, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and granting {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30+45 to 110+165}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
params.description3: '''Vel'Koz''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Void Rift'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1105|Ripple missile range}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1105|Rift collapse distance}}|{{tt|-95|Rift collapsing backwards distance}}}}
params.notes:
* {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} and {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} will block the ripple and prevent the rift from forming further, but they will not destroy the section that was created already.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.

blurb.plain: Active: Vel'Koz cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a brief delay, cascading through the area to deal magic damage to enemies within.

blurb2.plain: After a brief delay, the rift collapses, dealing magic damage to enemies within.

blurb3.plain: Vel'Koz periodically stocks a charge of Void Rift, up to a maximum of 2.

description.plain: Active: Vel'Koz cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a 0.25-second delay, cascading through the area over 0.65 seconds to deal magic damage to enemies within.

description2.plain: After 0.75 seconds, the rift violently collapses, dealing magic damage to enemies within and granting sight of the surrounding area for 0.25 seconds.

description3.plain: Vel'Koz periodically stocks a Void Rift charge, up to a maximum of 2.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} hurls a disruptive anomaly at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stuns}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' hurls a disruptive anomaly that lands to the target location after {{pp|0.25;0.25 to 0.55|0;150 to 800 by 50|type=cast distance|formula=0.25 until 150 cast distance; 0.25 + 0.3 * (cast distance - 150) / 650 until maximum cast distance}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area briefly.
params.description2: If ''Tectonic Disruption'' is cast in close proximity of '''Vel'Koz''', the anomaly will also slightly {{tip|airborne|knock back}} enemies hit in the direction of the cast.

blurb.plain: Active: Vel'Koz hurls a disruptive anomaly at the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit, briefly knocks them up and stuns them.

description.plain: Active: Vel'Koz hurls a disruptive anomaly that lands to the target location after ⟦pp⟧ seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and knocking them up and stunning them for 0.75 seconds, as well as granting sight of the area briefly.

description2.plain: If Tectonic Disruption is cast in close proximity of Vel'Koz, the anomaly will also slightly knock back enemies hit in the direction of the cast.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive - Researched:}} Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks will mark the target ''Researched'' for a few seconds, which refreshes on basic attacks and ability hits.
params.blurb2:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time to project an energy beam that continually deals {{as|magic damage}}, applies ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'', and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit. During this time, '''Vel'Koz''' can steer the beam in the target direction.
''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz}} Bonus:}} The beam deals {{as|true damage}} instead.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive - Researched:}} Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks to an enemy {{tip|champion}} marks them as ''Researched'' for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.2}}-second delay, '''Vel'Koz''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.6}} seconds to project an energy beam, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. ''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast after 1 second during the channel, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.description3: The beam deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit every {{fd|0.2}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20%, lingering for 1 second. ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'' is applied every {{fd|0.7}} seconds to enemies hit. {{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz|''Researched''}} enemies take {{as|true damage}} instead.
params.notes:
* ''Life Form Disintegration Ray's'' direction updates gradually (moving the cursor from one side of '''Vel'Koz''' to the other will not make him rotate instantly).
* '''Vel'Koz''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} himself if the ray is near an enemy champion.
* The beam hits in a rectangular shape, intersecting with the edge of an enemy {{tip|gameplay radius}}.
** Because of this, the effect will hit enemies whose center location is to the sides and/or slightly behind Vel'Koz, as long as their radius intersects with the area.
